note: RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 Established state requires on UpdateMsgErr (Event 28): send UPDATE Message Error NOTIFICATION, zero ConnectRetryTimer, delete connection routes, release BGP resources, drop TCP, increment ConnectRetryCounter by 1, enter Idle. Reactor TestRFC4271EstablishedUpdateErrorReleasesTheConnection feeds a malformed MP_REACH_NLRI to a live Established Peer and asserts exactly one NOTIFICATION with Error Code 3, EOF, peer-down, session release, all three timers stopped, and counter 0->1; FSM tests check Event 28 increments counter vs Event 27 keeps it unchanged; RIB TestRFC4760PeerDownDeletesOnlyThatNeighborsRoutes verifies peer-down removes only that PeerOwner's routes; negative keeps Established on valid UPDATE.
